records.outcome: The Mise task graph fixes every repeatable Figma check.
records.motivation: Code Connect proof needs deterministic ordering and typed receipts.
records.why_this_path: The Mise task graph owns parsing, task links, hashes, and exit states.
records.expected_effect: A Figma design system run exposes missing or stale fixed evidence early.
records.proof: The Mise task graph records each fixed gate and dependency.
records.falsifier: The Figma design system leaves a repeatable check to unrecorded model choice.
records.failure_branch: Code Connect blocks and returns to mise-envelope.

records.outcome: A direct visual audit owns every Figma visual-quality decision.
records.motivation: A direct visual audit cannot be replaced by Figma node structure.
records.why_this_path: The direct visual audit owner makes current rendered-pixel judgments.
records.expected_effect: The Figma design system rejects unseen or visually weak output.
records.proof: Direct visual audit receipts name current pages, views, and findings.
records.falsifier: A direct visual audit PASS exists without current rendered pixels or sight.
records.failure_branch: Code Connect blocks and returns to direct-vision-owner.

records.outcome: Component property parity joins Figma properties to real code APIs.
records.motivation: Code Connect cannot repair a missing TypeScript React API.
records.why_this_path: Component property parity traces product need across Figma, code, mapping, and render.
records.expected_effect: Code Connect mappings stop inventing props or hiding nested gaps.
records.proof: Component property parity records every property kind and owner.
records.falsifier: A mapped Figma property lacks a real TypeScript React API or render.
records.failure_branch: Code Connect blocks and returns to property-parity-owner.

records.outcome: Figma design system mutations stay inside explicit human authority.
records.motivation: The Figma design system separates writes, publication, and deletion.
records.why_this_path: The Figma design system gives each exact permission to the human owner.
records.expected_effect: Code Connect work cannot silently publish or overwrite design state.
records.proof: Figma design system mutation receipts preserve authority and readback.
records.falsifier: The Figma design system has a mutation without exact human permission.
records.failure_branch: Code Connect blocks and returns to mutation-authority.

records.outcome: The Mise task graph keeps only nonregressing skill changes.
records.motivation: Code Connect workflow speed cannot trade away correctness or model judgment.
records.why_this_path: The Mise task graph owns the baseline, measures, comparison, and restore path.
records.expected_effect: Code Connect skill changes improve one part without harming another.
records.proof: The Mise task graph records before and after measures and digests.
records.falsifier: The Mise task graph finds a changed skill worse than its baseline.
records.failure_branch: Code Connect blocks and returns to safe-skill-change.
